Thanks for the very thorough review — addressed everything below.

Statement

    Added a credit for the Conway's Game of Life inspiration in The Goal.

    Defined "adjacent" and "neighbor" once in Rules → The Map, removed the duplicate inline definition from EXPAND.

    Energy: "calculated from" → "calculated as"; documented that both players always start with equal energy (guaranteed by the map's 180° symmetry).

    Actions table: narrowed Syntax, widened Effect, "Cost" → "Energy cost",  now wraps only x/y individually instead of the whole (x,y).

    Fog of War: x is now , 32 is now .

    Victory/Defeat Conditions rebuilt using the standard statement-victory-conditions/icon victory and statement-lose-conditions/icon lose markup, with an explicit Defeat Conditions section, an explicit definition of cells/energy in the score formula, and documented behavior for insufficient energy and duplicate same-cell targets.

    Expert Rules: added the icon-expertrules icon, wrapped action names in , defined "phase snapshot" and "attack-phase snapshot" precisely, clarified that a tie-broken EXPAND still costs energy, removed the reachability guarantee, moved the symmetry rule to the top, added a link to the referee source.

    Input/Output: restored the "Next N lines" wording per your suggested replacements, line numbers now use statement-lineno, every variable is described, removed the duplicate explanatory paragraph.

    Removed the redundant "Max actions per turn" row from Constraints.

    Moved the coordinate-system note into The Map section; the Example Turn now shows the actual initialization input (which was missing) plus turn 1 input, both as two-column tables instead of a prose paragraph.

AUTOPHAGY → APOPTOSIS
Renamed the self-sacrifice action everywhere — autophagy is a eukaryote-only process and doesn't apply to bacteria; apoptosis (programmed cell death) is the closer fit.

Console
Replaced raw TURN_STAGE/TURN_EVENT JSON with concise one-liners, dropped internal stage noise and no-op WAIT logging, and the summary now states the winner explicitly.

Viewer
Increased HUD font sizes for legibility outside fullscreen, added an on-screen winner banner.

Starting distance
Increased vision radius (3→5) so players discover each other earlier. Left map size/spawns unchanged for now — bigger structural call best made after actual playtesting.

It looks exactly like two slime molds competing for oatmeal flakes. Even the tube regression mechanism is identical to the so-called 'autophagy' action in this game.

BTW, as far as I know, bacteria do not use autophagy. Autophagy is characteristic of a more advanced cellular structure, which only eukaryotes possess. So the term 'autophagy' is technically inappropriate here.

I noticed your contribution shortly after it appeared. For now, some quick comments first.

Rules
* Was the ▶ intentionally placed above each heading? I think it might look more natural if it appeared to the left of the heading instead.

* Fog of War: How is "your half" defined?

Advanced Details
* This section is usually titled "Technical Details" or "Expert Rules", with an icon before it (as in the example).

Victory and Defeat Conditions
* These sections usually follow a standard format like the example. I'd suggest formatting the Victory Conditions section the same way and adding a corresponding Defeat Conditions section.

Input / Output
* Please format the line numbers like the example.

Example Turn
* The example input (single line) doesn't match the documented input format (multiple lines).

Viewer

I'll try to provide a more in-depth review as soon as I can.

First, please switch the contribution's status back to WIP immediately. Please don't change it back to Ready simply because you believe you've addressed the comments below. The Goal * If this puzzle is inspired by or based on an existing game, please include an appropriate credit. Rules - The Map * Please define "adjacent" in this section, since the term is used several times throughout the statement. Once it's defined here, you can remove the definition from the EXPAND action. * "Neighbor" is mentioned twice (for ATTACK and the EXPAND tie-break) but is never defined. Please define it here as well. Rules - Energy * Please change "from" to "as". * Please specify whether both players always start with the same amount of energy. Rules - Actions * Consider adjusting the table column widths. The "Syntax" column could be narrower, giving more space to the longer descriptions in "Effect". * If "Cost" refers specifically to energy, please rename the column to "Energy cost". * For EXPAND, ATTACK and AUTOPHAGY, please apply to "x" and "y" only, rather than the entire (x,y) expression. * As mentioned by @Konstant, consider replacing AUTOPHAGY with a biologically more accurate term. Rules - Fog of War * Please format both instances of "x" using instead of . * Please format both instances of 32 using . Victory and Defeat Conditions * Please use the standard statement formatting: • Victory Conditions:
• Defeat Conditions:
* Please make the scoring formula more explicit by defining what "cells" and "energy" refer to. * What happens if a player attempts EXPAND or ATTACK without having enough energy? If this results in a defeat, please include it here; otherwise, explain the behaviour in the Expert Rules. * What happens if a player issues multiple EXPAND or ATTACK actions targeting the same cell during a single turn? Are the repeated actions executed independently, ignored, or considered invalid output? Please explain in the statement. Expert Rules * Please add   before the heading. * Please format all action names using . * (Points 2 & 3) Please clarify what "phase snapshot" means. Is it the state of the grid at the start of a turn? * (Point 4) Please clarify what "attack-phase snapshot" means. Is it the state of the grid immediately after all EXPAND actions have been resolved? * (Point 5) Please clarify whether an EXPAND that loses a tie-break still costs energy. * (Final point) "Nutrient spots are guaranteed reachable from both starting positions": Consider removing the guarantee. I can't think of a situation where nutrient spots can be unreachable other than being blocked by an enemy. * Consider moving the map symmetry rule to the beginning of this section. * Consider providing a link to the referee source code.

Constraints

Example Turn
* Please move the explanation of the coordinate system into "Rules - The Map" and merge it with the existing description.

* The example input still doesn't follow the documented input format. Please split it into separate lines exactly as a player's program would receive it.

* Likewise, consider presenting the accompanying explanation as a two-column table, with each input line on the left and its explanation on the right.

Console
* At the moment the game summary shown in the console consists of lines such as:

TURN_STAGE {"turn":1,"stage":"INPUT_GENERATION"}
TURN_EVENT {"turn":1,"phase":"EXPAND",...}

This is difficult to read as a human and differs noticeably from the summaries used by most existing multiplayer games on CodinGame, which present turn events in a much more concise and readable format.

Viewer
* The font size is too small. The viewer text should remain legible even when not displayed in fullscreen mode.

* Neither the console nor the viewer indicates the winner when a game ends.

I haven't play-tested the game yet. I'll do so after the points above have been addressed.

You're welcome. I have the following comments after reviewing the latest version. The Goal * Please delete "all" and "before the turn limit" for a smoother transition into the subsequent sentence. * Please remove the inspiration paragraph. My earlier suggestion was based on the possibility that the game was a close adaptation of an existing one, but it now appears to be only loosely inspired, which generally doesn't require attribution. Rules - The Map * Please format all action names using . Rules - Actions * Please remove "If the placement is invalid, the energy cost is still spent (wasted move)." to avoid repetition. * Please remove the two paragraphs ("Combine multiple … APOPTOSIS → WAIT.") to avoid repetition. Rules - Fog of War * Please change "split down" to "split in". * Please change "your starting" to "the player's starting". Victory and Defeat Conditions * Please replace

You win if:

with:
Victory Conditions
and add two
after . * Please change "number of cells you own" to "your current number of cells". * Please replace

You lose if:

with:
Defeat Conditions
and add two
after . * Please remove the whole sentence: "Trying to EXPAND or ATTACK … what happens instead." to avoid repetition. Expert Rules * Please remove the first point to avoid repetition. * "Each turn, all players receive input and output is collected before any action is resolved": It's not technically accurate. For example, if both players output an invalid line, Player 1 still wins because the referee stops as soon as it detects Player 0's invalid output and immediately declares them the loser. * Please format all action names using . * Please change "lower player index" to "Player 0". * Please add the following bullet point after the resolution-order rule: In this section, phase snapshot refers to the state of the grid before a phase begins, i.e. before any actions in that phase are applied. * Please replace "phase snapshot — the state of the grid at the start of the turn, before any of this turn's actions are applied)" with "expand-phase snapshot". * EXPAND adjacency: Please replace "phase snapshot" with "expand-phase snapshot". * Please replace "— the state of the grid immediately after all EXPAND actions for the turn have been resolved — then" with ", and". * I don't understand what "successful captures are applied deterministically by target coordinate order" means. Also, what is its significance? * failed EXPAND: Please include "out of bounds" as one of the conditions. * failed ATTACK: Please include "out of bounds" and "not enemy's cell". * failed APOPTOSIS: Please include "out of bounds". * The referee source code doesn't appear to have been updated.

Input / Output
* Please format all line numbers ("Next <var>…</var> lines:" and "Next line:") using <span class="statement-lineno">.

* Please change "position" to "coordinates" (once in "Initialization input", once in "Input per turn").

* Please use the same variables as those in the stub:
  • spotX, spotY, spotType
  • myX, myY
  • oppX, oppY
  • sX, sY, sType, sEnergy

Example Turn
* Please change
  • "Your" to "Player 0's".
  • "You spend" to "Player 0 spends".

Invalid action examples
* Please remove this section.
  • These are failed actions instead of invalid ones.
  • The examples lack enough context to be meaningful. For example, ATTACK 4 4 is said to fail due to insufficient numerical superiority, but the surrounding board state isn't shown.
  In any case, the Expert Rules should already make these behaviours clear.

Stub
* Final comment: Please change "Invalid" to "Failed".

Viewer
* Please increase the font size further (e.g. by 50%) and make better use of the available space in the viewer.

Boss
* The boss timed out quickly, even after your most recent update an hour ago: https://www.codingame.com/replay/897361178

Referee / Console
* In one game I output EXPAND 9 8 three times in the same turn. The console reported:
EXPAND 9 8: OK
EXPAND 9 8: failed - lost the tie-break for that cell
EXPAND 9 8: failed - lost the tie-break for that cell

The reported failed reason is incorrect.

By comparison, if I output EXPAND 9 8 in one turn and again in the next turn, the message is correct:
EXPAND 9 8: failed - target occupied or not adjacent

* The referee handles out-of-bound conditions inconsistently. Negative coordinates (e.g. EXPAND -1 -1) are treated as invalid output causing defeat, while positive coordinates beyond the map (e.g. EXPAND 64 64) are treated as failed actions.

* Please update any error messages that use "invalid" when they actually refer to a failed action, e.g. "EXPAND 64 64: invalid - out of bounds".

* Outputting "EXPAND 58 58 62" doesn't result in defeat as stated in the defeat conditions (wrong number of arguments). The console just reports:
EXPAND 58 58: failed - target occupied or not adjacent

* The EXPAND tie-break appears to be incorrect in this replay: https://www.codingame.com/replay/897357327 (frame 69). I'd expect Player 0 to win because both players have the same neighbour count around the target cell.

* In the same replay, why does the game end after 188 turns (not 300)?

* When displaying the final scores, the console shows "P0" and "P1" instead of the players' names.

* Consider displaying the final scores on separate lines rather than a single line, as currently the line may be too long to show a player's name and their score on the same line.

* I have more play-testing to do, but I think it's better for me to wait until this round of comments have been addressed. I also recommend you doing another round of play-testing.

Cover image
* A dot in missing in the title shown in the cover image.

Thanks.
